properties.NAME: ST. LOUIS (Mo.)
properties.CHANGE: The United States divided the Louisiana Purchase into the District of Louisiana and Orleans Territory. The portion of present Wyo east of the Rocky Mountains became part of the District of Louisiana. The District of Louisiana created ST. LOUIS District.

properties.NAME: Oregon Country
properties.CHANGE: The United States claimed the Oregon Country, including that part of present Wyoming west of the Continental Divide, based on American exploration of the Northwest. No boundaries were defined, and Spain also claimed the area.

properties.NAME: Missouri Terr.
properties.CHANGE: That part of present Wyoming east of the Continental Divide became non-county area in Missouri Territory.

properties.NAME: Mexico
properties.CHANGE: That part of present Wyo. S of 42 deg. N lat. and W of a line running N from the headwaters of Ark. Riv. in present Colorado officially came under Spanish control when Adams-Onis Treaty bet. U.S. and Spain established the boundaries of the U.S. terr.

properties.NAME: Missouri Terr.
properties.CHANGE: The boundary of Missouri Territory was altered when the Adams-Onis Treaty between the United States and Spain established the southern and western boundaries of the United States territory south of the parallel of 42 degrees north latitude.

properties.NAME: Oregon Country
properties.CHANGE: The southern boundary of the Oregon Country was set at 42 degrees north latitude when the Adams-Onis Treaty between the United States and Spain established the southern and western boundaries of the United States territory.

properties.NAME: Unorg. Fed. Terr.
properties.CHANGE: That part of Missouri Territory in present Wyoming reverted to unorganized federal territory upon the creation of the state of Missouri.

properties.NAME: Mexico
properties.CHANGE: The Republic of Mexico lost territory to the Republic of Texas when the boundaries of the Texas Republic were defined.
properties.CITATION: "Mexican War of Independence," New Handbook of Texas, 4:698

properties.NAME: BEXAR (Tex.)
properties.CHANGE: BEXAR (Texas) boundaries were implicitly expanded to cover all non-county area in the Republic of Texas when boundaries of the Texas Rep. were defined. BEXAR included territory in present Tex., Col., Kan., New Mex., Ok., and part of present southern Wyo.

properties.NAME: CHAMPOEG (Ore.)
properties.CHANGE: CHAMPOEG District (now MARION Ore) created by the Oregon Territory Provisional Government as one of four original districts; included territory in present Oregon, Idaho, and all that part of present Wyoming N of 42 degrees N lat and W of the Rocky Mtns.

properties.NAME: LINN (Ore.)
properties.CHANGE: LINN (Ore.) created by the Oregon Territory Provisional Legislature from CHAMPOEG (now MARION [Ore.]). LINN included territory in present Oregon, Idaho, and all that part of present Wyoming north of 42 degrees north latitude and west of the Rocky Mtns.

properties.NAME: Unorg. Fed. Terr.
properties.CHANGE: Treaty of Guadalupe-Hidalgo ended the Mexican War between the United States and Mexico. Mexico ceded territory that included part of present southwestern Wyoming to the United States. This area was Unorganized Federal Territory (non-county area).
properties.CITATION: Parry, 102:29-59; U.S. Stat., vol. 9, pp. 922-943; Van Zandt, 11, 28

properties.NAME: SANTA FE (Tex., ext)
properties.CHANGE: SANTA FE (Texas, extinct) created by the state of Texas from BEXAR (Texas). SANTA FE included territory in present Texas, Colorado, Kansas, New Mexico, Oklahoma, and part of present southern Wyoming; only the portion in Wyoming is mapped here.

properties.NAME: Unorg. Fed. Terr.
properties.CHANGE: Unorganized Federal Territory (non-county area) in present Wyoming gained territory to be purchased from the state of Texas in Dec 1850, and lost to creation of Utah Territory.

properties.NAME: Utah Terr.
properties.CHANGE: The United States created Utah Terr. from the territory ceded by Mexico in the Treaty of Guadalupe-Hidalgo (1848), from territory to be purchased from the state of Tex. in Dec 1850, and from Unorg. Fed. Terr.

properties.NAME: LINN (Ore.)
properties.CHANGE: LINN (Ore.) lost to creation of LANE (Ore.); LINN still included part of present Wyoming.
properties.CITATION: Ore. Terr. Laws 1850, 2d sess., loc., pp. 32-34

properties.NAME: LANE (Ore.)
properties.CHANGE: LANE (Ore.) created by Oregon Territory from BENTON (Ore.) and LINN (Ore.). LANE included territory in present Oregon, Idaho, and most of present Wyoming north of 42 degrees north latitude and west of the Rocky Mountains.
properties.CITATION: Ore. Terr. Laws 1850, 2d sess., loc., pp. 32-34

properties.NAME: LANE (Ore.)
properties.CHANGE: LANE (Ore.) lost small area to creation of DOUGLAS (Ore.); area within present Wyoming was unchanged.

properties.NAME: GREEN RIVER (Ut Ter)
properties.CHANGE: GREEN RIVER (Utah Terr., extinct) created by Utah Terr. from non-county area; included territory in present Utah, Colorado, and the southwestern section of present Wyo. GREEN RIVER not fully org., att. to GREAT SALT LAKE (now SALT LAKE [Ut.]).

properties.NAME: LANE (Ore.)
properties.CHANGE: LANE (Ore.) exchanged with DOUGLAS (Ore.) and UMPQUA (Ore., extinct); area within present Wyoming was unchanged.
properties.CITATION: Ore. Terr. Laws 1853, 5th sess., spec., p. 13

properties.NAME: Nebraska Terr.
properties.CHANGE: The United States created Nebraska Territory from Unorganized Federal Territory; included all of present Wyoming east of the Continental Divide.
properties.CITATION: U.S. Stat., vol. 10, ch. 59[1854]/pp. 277-290; Van Zandt, 136

properties.NAME: WASCO (Ore.)
properties.CHANGE: WASCO (Ore.) created by Oregon Territory from CLACKAMAS (Ore.), JACKSON (Ore.), LANE (Ore.), LINN (Ore.), and MARION (Ore.); included territory in present Ore., Ida., Mont., and all that part of present Wyo. N of 42 degrees N lat and W of the Rocky Mtns.
properties.CITATION: Ore. Terr. Laws 1853, 5th sess., spec., pp. 26-27

properties.NAME: GREEN RIVER (Ut Ter)
properties.CHANGE: GREEN RIVER (Utah Terr., extinct) gained from GREAT SALT LAKE (now SALT LAKE [Utah]), SANPETE (Utah), and UTAH (Utah); lost to DAVIS (Utah) and lost to creation of SUMMIT (Utah).

properties.NAME: SUMMIT (Utah)
properties.CHANGE: SUMMIT (Utah) created by Utah Terr. from GREEN RIVER (Utah Terr., extinct) and GREAT SALT LAKE (now SALT LAKE [Utah]); SUMMIT included territory in present Utah and Wyo. SUMMIT not fully org., att. to GREAT SALT LAKE "for elec., rev. and jud. purposes"

properties.NAME: CACHE (Utah)
properties.CHANGE: CACHE (Utah) created by Utah Territory from SUMMIT (Utah) and WEBER (Utah); CACHE included territory in present Utah and Wyoming. CACHE not fully organized.

properties.NAME: SUMMIT (Utah)
properties.CHANGE: SUMMIT lost to creation of CACHE.

properties.NAME: Washington Terr.
properties.CHANGE: Washington Territory gained non-county area in present Wyoming when state of Oregon was created.

properties.NAME: Nebraska Terr.
properties.CHANGE: MORTON (Nebraska Terr., extinct) and WILSON (Nebraska Terr., extinct) created by Nebraska Territory from non-county area in present Wyoming. It appears no attempt was made to organize these counties, and their existence was ignored.

properties.NAME: WILSON (Nebr., ext)
properties.CHANGE: WILSON (Nebraska Terr., extinct) created by Nebraska Territory from non-county area in present Wyoming. It appears no attempt was made to organize WILSON, and its existence was ignored.

properties.NAME: MORTON (Nebr., ext)
properties.CHANGE: MORTON (Nebraska Terr., extinct) created by Nebraska Territory from non-county area in present Wyoming. It appears no attempt was made to organize MORTON, and its existence was ignored.

properties.NAME: IDAHO (Idaho)
properties.CHANGE: IDAHO (Idaho) created by Washington Territory from SHOSHONE (Idaho); included territory in present Idaho, Montana, and Wyoming.

properties.NAME: Dakota Terr.
properties.CHANGE: The United States created Dakota Territory from Nebraska Territory and Unorganized Federal Territory; included the northern part of present Wyoming east of the Continental Divide.
properties.CITATION: Dak. Terr. Laws 1862, 1st sess., pp. 21-28; U.S. Stat., vol. 12, ch. 86[1861]/pp. 239-244; Van Zandt, 134, 136-137

properties.NAME: Nebraska Terr.
properties.CHANGE: Nebraska Territory gained from Utah and Washington Territories, lost to creation of Dakota Territory. Nebraska Territory included the southern part of present Wyoming east of 33 degrees longitude west of Washington, D.C.
properties.CITATION: Dak. Terr. Laws 1862, 1st sess., pp. 21-28; U.S. Stat., vol. 12, ch. 86[1861]/pp. 239-244; Van Zandt, 134, 136-137

properties.NAME: SHOSHONE (Idaho)
properties.CHANGE: SHOSHONE (Idaho) lost to Nebraska Territory when Nebraska Territory gained area in present Wyoming from Washington Territory.

properties.NAME: GREEN RIVER (Ut Ter)
properties.CHANGE: GREEN RIVER (Utah Terr., extinct) lost to Nebraska Territory when Nebraska Territory gained area in present Wyoming from Utah Territory.

properties.NAME: SHOSHONE (Idaho)
properties.CHANGE: SHOSHONE (Idaho) created by Washington Territory from SPOKANE (Wash. Terr., original, extinct) and non-county area; included territory in present Idaho, Montana, and that part of present Wyoming west of the Rocky Mountains and north of 42 degrees N lat

properties.NAME: GREEN RIVER (Ut Ter)
properties.CHANGE: The United States created Colorado Territory from Nebraska, New Mexico, and Utah Territories, and from the remnant of Kansas Territory. GREEN RIVER (Utah Terr., extinct) lost to Colorado Territory; area within present Wyoming was unchanged.

properties.NAME: Idaho Terr.
properties.CHANGE: Idaho Territory (non-county area) lost to creation of OWYHEE (Idaho).

properties.NAME: Idaho Terr.
properties.CHANGE: The United States created Idaho Territory from Dakota, Nebraska, and Washington Territories; all of present Wyoming except the southwestern corner and BOISE (Idaho) became non-county area in Idaho Territory.

properties.NAME: Dakota Terr.
properties.CHANGE: Dakota Territory gained from Idaho Territory; most of present Wyoming became non-county area in Dakota Territory.

properties.NAME: ONEIDA (Idaho)
properties.CHANGE: ONEIDA (Idaho) created by Idaho Territory from BOISE (Idaho) and OWYHEE (Idaho); included territory in present Idaho and most of present Wyoming west of the Rocky Mountains.

properties.NAME: YELLOWSTONE (Id Ter)
properties.CHANGE: YELLOWSTONE (Idaho Terr., extinct) created by Idaho Territory from non-county area. YELLOWSTONE was located entirely within present Wyoming.

properties.NAME: OGALALA (Idaho Terr)
properties.CHANGE: OGALALA (Idaho Terr., extinct) created by Idaho Territory from non-county area. OGALALA was located in the eastern half of present Wyoming.

properties.NAME: RICHLAND (Utah)
properties.CHANGE: RICHLAND (now RICH [Utah]) created by Utah Territory from CACHE (Utah); RICHLAND included territory in present Utah and Wyoming. RICHLAND not fully organized.

properties.NAME: LARAMIE
properties.CHANGE: LARAMIE lost to creation of CARTER (now SWEETWATER). CARTER not fully organized, attached to LARAMIE "for representative and judicial purposes."

properties.NAME: CARTER
properties.CHANGE: CARTER (now SWEETWATER) created by Dakota Territory from LARAMIE; included a small area of present Montana. CARTER not fully organized, attached to LARAMIE "for representative and judicial purposes."

properties.NAME: LARAMIE
properties.CHANGE: LARAMIE created by Dakota Territory from non-county area; included all of present Wyoming that was then part of Dakota Territory, plus a small area of present Montana.

properties.NAME: CARBON
properties.CHANGE: CARBON created by Dakota Territory from LARAMIE. Error in the definition of CARBON's southern boundary was corrected 1 January 1870 by the Wyoming Territorial Legislature.
properties.CITATION: Dak. Terr. Laws 1868, 8th sess., ch. 35/p. 321; Trenholm, 1:84, 334

properties.NAME: CARTER
properties.CHANGE: CARTER (now SWEETWATER) lost small area in present Montana when Wyoming Territory boundaries were defined.

properties.NAME: ALBANY
properties.CHANGE: ALBANY created by Dakota Territory from LARAMIE. Error in the definition of ALBANY's western boundary was corrected 13 December 1869 by the Wyoming Territorial Legislature.
properties.CITATION: Dak. Terr. Laws 1868, 8th sess., ch. 28/p. 311; Trenholm, 1:84, 334

properties.NAME: LARAMIE
properties.CHANGE: LARAMIE lost to creation of ALBANY and CARBON.
properties.CITATION: Dak. Terr. Laws 1868, 8th sess., chs. 28, 35/pp. 311, 321; Trenholm, 1:84, 334

properties.NAME: NCA
properties.CHANGE: All that part of present Wyoming west of a line from 33 degrees longitude west of Washington, D.C., north to the Rocky Mountains became non-county-area in Wyoming Territory.

properties.NAME: RICH (Utah)
properties.CHANGE: RICHLAND renamed RICH (Utah).

properties.NAME: SWEETWATER
properties.CHANGE: CARTER renamed SWEETWATER; boundaries redefined (no mappable change)
properties.CITATION: Wyo. Terr. Laws 1869, 1st leg., ch. 35/pp. 383-385; Whitehead, 194-196

properties.NAME: CARTER
properties.CHANGE: CARTER (now SWEETWATER) lost to creation of UINTA, implicitly exchanged non-county areas.
properties.CITATION: Wyo. Terr. Laws 1869, 1st leg., ch. 34/p. 382; Whitehead, 194

properties.NAME: UINTA
properties.CHANGE: UINTA created by Wyoming Territory from CARTER (now SWEETWATER) and non-county area.
properties.CITATION: Wyo. Terr. Laws 1869, 1st leg., ch. 34/p. 382; Whitehead, 194

properties.NAME: ALBANY
properties.CHANGE: ALBANY lost a half-mile-wide strip of territory to CARBON all along ALBANY's western boundary.
properties.CITATION: Wyo. Terr. Laws 1869, 1st leg., ch. 37/pp. 387-388; Whitehead, 197

properties.NAME: CARBON
properties.CHANGE: CARBON gained a half-mile-wide strip of territory from ALBANY all along CARBON's eastern boundary. Mistake in description dating from 16 December 1868 was corrected.
properties.CITATION: Wyo. Terr. Laws 1869, 1st leg., ch. 37/pp. 387-388; Whitehead, 197

properties.NAME: SWEETWATER
properties.CHANGE: SWEETWATER lost to creation of PEASE (now JOHNSON). PEASE not fully organized, part attached to SWEETWATER "for judicial and all other purposes."

properties.NAME: LARAMIE
properties.CHANGE: LARAMIE lost to creation of CROOK. CROOK not fully organized, part attached to LARAMIE "for judicial and all other purposes."

properties.NAME: PEASE
properties.CHANGE: PEASE (now JOHNSON; renamed 13 Dec 1879) created by Wyoming Territory from ALBANY, CARBON and SWEETWATER. PEASE not fully organized, attached to ALBANY, CARBON, and SWEETWATER "for judicial and all other purposes."

properties.NAME: ALBANY
properties.CHANGE: ALBANY lost to creation of CROOK and PEASE (now JOHNSON). CROOK and PEASE not fully organized, parts attached to ALBANY "for judicial and all other purposes."

properties.NAME: CARBON
properties.CHANGE: CARBON lost to creation of PEASE (now JOHNSON). PEASE not fully organized, part attached to CARBON "for judicial and all other purposes."

properties.NAME: CROOK
properties.CHANGE: CROOK created by Wyoming Territory from ALBANY and LARAMIE; CROOK not fully organized, attached to ALBANY and LARAMIE "for judicial and all other purposes."
properties.CITATION: Whitehead, 198-201; "Crook County v. Sheridan County," in Wyoming Rpts., 17:424-467

properties.NAME: JOHNSON
properties.CHANGE: PEASE renamed JOHNSON (no mappable change).

properties.NAME: SWEETWATER
properties.CHANGE: SWEETWATER lost to creation of FREMONT. FREMONT not fully organized, attached to SWEETWATER "for judicial and all other purposes."

properties.NAME: FREMONT
properties.CHANGE: FREMONT created by Wyoming Territory from SWEETWATER; FREMONT not fully organized, attached to SWEETWATER "for judicial and all other purposes."

properties.NAME: SWEETWATER
properties.CHANGE: SWEETWATER lost to CARBON.
properties.CITATION: Wyo. Terr. Laws 1886, 9th leg., ch. 5, sec. 5/pp. 6-8

properties.NAME: ALBANY
properties.CHANGE: ALBANY gained from CARBON.

properties.NAME: CARBON
properties.CHANGE: CARBON gained from SWEETWATER, lost to ALBANY.

properties.NAME: ALBANY
properties.CHANGE: ALBANY lost to creation of CONVERSE. CONVERSE not fully organized, part attached to ALBANY for administrative and judicial purposes.
properties.CITATION: Wyo. Terr. Laws 1888, 10th leg., ch. 90, sec. 60/p. 217

properties.NAME: CARBON
properties.CHANGE: CARBON lost to creation of NATRONA. NATRONA not fully organized, attached to CARBON for administrative and judicial purposes.
properties.CITATION: Wyo. Terr. Laws 1888, 10th leg., ch. 90, sec. 61/pp. 217-218

properties.NAME: NATRONA
properties.CHANGE: NATRONA created by Wyoming Territory from CARBON; NATRONA not fully organized, attached to CARBON for administrative and judicial purposes.
properties.CITATION: Wyo. Terr. Laws 1888, 10th leg., ch. 90, sec. 61/pp. 217-218

properties.NAME: CONVERSE
properties.CHANGE: CONVERSE created by Wyoming Territory from ALBANY and LARAMIE; CONVERSE not fully organized, attached to ALBANY and LARAMIE for administrative and judicial purposes.
properties.CITATION: Wyo. Terr. Laws 1888, 10th leg., ch. 90, sec. 60/p. 217

properties.NAME: LARAMIE
properties.CHANGE: LARAMIE lost to creation of CONVERSE. CONVERSE not fully organized, part attached to LARAMIE for administrative and judicial purposes.
properties.CITATION: Wyo. Terr. Laws 1888, 10th leg., ch. 90, sec. 60/p. 217

properties.NAME: JOHNSON
properties.CHANGE: JOHNSON lost to creation of SHERIDAN. SHERIDAN not fully organized, attached to JOHNSON for administrative and judicial purposes.
properties.CITATION: Wyo. Terr. Laws 1888, 10th leg., ch. 90, sec. 62/p. 218

properties.NAME: SHERIDAN
properties.CHANGE: SHERIDAN created by Wyoming Territory from JOHNSON; SHERIDAN not fully organized, attached to JOHNSON for administrative and judicial purposes.
properties.CITATION: Wyo. Terr. Laws 1888, 10th leg., ch. 90, sec. 62/p. 218; "Crook County v. Sheridan County," in Wyoming Rpts., 17:424-467

properties.NAME: JOHNSON
properties.CHANGE: JOHNSON lost to creation of BIG HORN. BIG HORN not fully organized, part attached to JOHNSON "for judicial, revenue and election purposes."

properties.NAME: SHERIDAN
properties.CHANGE: SHERIDAN lost to creation of BIG HORN; BIG HORN not fully organized, part attached to SHERIDAN "for judicial, revenue and election purposes."

properties.NAME: BIG HORN
properties.CHANGE: BIG HORN created by Wyoming Territory from FREMONT, JOHNSON, and SHERIDAN; BIG HORN not fully organized, attached to FREMONT, JOHNSON, and SHERIDAN "for judicial, revenue and election purposes."

properties.NAME: WESTON
properties.CHANGE: WESTON created by Wyoming Territory from CROOK. WESTON not fully organized, attached to CROOK for administrative and judicial purposes.

properties.NAME: CROOK
properties.CHANGE: CROOK lost to creation of WESTON. WESTON not fully organized, attached to CROOK for administrative and judicial purposes.

properties.NAME: FREMONT
properties.CHANGE: FREMONT lost to creation of BIG HORN. BIG HORN not fully organized, part attached to FREMONT "for judicial, revenue and election purposes."

properties.NAME: FREMONT
properties.CHANGE: FREMONT lost to CARBON and NATRONA when boundary was adjusted to run on federal land survey lines.

properties.NAME: BIG HORN
properties.CHANGE: BIG HORN lost to creation of PARK. PARK not fully organized, attached to BIG HORN "for judicial, revenue and election purposes."

properties.NAME: PARK
properties.CHANGE: PARK created from BIG HORN; PARK not fully organized, attached to BIG HORN "for judicial, revenue and election purposes."

properties.NAME: CARBON
properties.CHANGE: CARBON gained small area from FREMONT and exchanged with SWEETWATER when boundaries were adjusted to run on federal land survey lines.

properties.NAME: SWEETWATER
properties.CHANGE: SWEETWATER exchanged with CARBON when boundary was adjusted to run on federal land survey lines.

properties.NAME: NATRONA
properties.CHANGE: NATRONA gained from FREMONT.

properties.NAME: BIG HORN
properties.CHANGE: BIG HORN lost to creation of HOT SPRINGS and WASHAKIE. HOT SPRINGS and WASHAKIE not fully org, part of HOT SPRINGS and all of WASHAKIE attached to BIG HORN "for judicial, revenue and election purposes." BIG HORN boundaries were redefined to run on FLSL

properties.NAME: WASHAKIE
properties.CHANGE: WASHAKIE created from BIG HORN. WASHAKIE not fully org, attached to BIG HORN "for judicial, revenue and election purposes." Technically, WASHAKIE had been created on 9 February 1911, but the mapping reflects intent of legislature.

properties.NAME: CAMPBELL
properties.CHANGE: CAMPBELL created from CROOK and WESTON. CAMPBELL not fully org, attached to CROOK and WESTON "for judicial, revenue and election purposes." Technically, CAMPBELL had been created on 13 February 1911, but the mapping reflects the intent of the legislature

properties.NAME: SWEETWATER
properties.CHANGE: SWEETWATER lost to CARBON, and lost along western boundary to UINTA and former part of UINTA (now LINCOLN) when boundaries were adjusted to run on federal land survey lines.

properties.NAME: CARBON
properties.CHANGE: CARBON gained from SWEETWATER, boundary with ALBANY was adjusted to run on federal land survey lines.

properties.NAME: CROOK
properties.CHANGE: CROOK lost to creation of CAMPBELL. CAMPBELL not fully org, part attached to CROOK "for judicial, revenue and election purposes." CROOK boundaries redefined to run on federal land survey lines.

properties.NAME: WESTON
properties.CHANGE: WESTON lost to creation of CAMPBELL. CAMPBELL not fully organized, part attached to WESTON "for judicial, revenue and election purposes." The southern boundary of WESTON was adjusted to run on federal land survey lines.

properties.NAME: GOSHEN
properties.CHANGE: GOSHEN created from LARAMIE. GOSHEN not fully organized, attached to LARAMIE "for judicial, revenue and elective purposes." Technically, GOSHEN had been created on 9 February 1911, but the mapping reflects the intent of the legislature.

properties.NAME: PLATTE
properties.CHANGE: PLATTE created from LARAMIE. PLATTE not fully organized, attached to LARAMIE "for judicial, revenue and elective purposes." Technically, PLATTE had been created on 9 February 1911, but the mapping reflects the intent of the legislature.

properties.NAME: LARAMIE
properties.CHANGE: LARAMIE lost to creation of GOSHEN and PLATTE. GOSHEN and PLATTE not fully organized, attached to LARAMIE "for judicial, revenue and elective purposes." LARAMIE lost to ALBANY when boundary was adjusted to run on federal land survey lines.

properties.NAME: NIOBRARA
properties.CHANGE: NIOBRARA created from CONVERSE. NIOBRARA not fully organized, attached to CONVERSE "for judicial, revenue and election purposes." Technically, NIOBRARA had been created on 14 February 1911, but the mapping reflects the intent of the legislature.

properties.NAME: UINTA
properties.CHANGE: UINTA lost to creation of LINCOLN and lost to Yellowstone NP. LINCOLN not fully organized, attached to UINTA "for judicial, revenue and election purposes." UINTA gained from SWEETWATER when boundary was adjusted to run on federal land survey lines.
properties.CITATION: Wyo. Laws 1911, 11th leg., ch. 67/pp. 93-94 and ch. 77, secs. 12-13/pp. 111-113

properties.NAME: ALBANY
properties.CHANGE: ALBANY gained from LARAMIE and former part of LARAMIE (now PLATTE) when boundary was adjusted to run on federal land survey lines; boundary with CARBON was adjusted to run on federal land survey lines.

properties.NAME: SHERIDAN
properties.CHANGE: SHERIDAN lost territory along former boundary with CROOK when boundary was adjusted to run on federal land survey line. Southern boundary of SHERIDAN was clarified [no change].

properties.NAME: JOHNSON
properties.CHANGE: -JOHNSON lost territory along former boundary with CROOK and WESTON when boundaries were redefined to run on federal land survey lines. JOHNSON gained from NATRONA when southern boundary was adjusted to run on federal land survey lines.

properties.NAME: HOT SPRINGS
properties.CHANGE: HOT SPRINGS created from BIG HORN, FREMONT, and PARK. HOT SPRINGS not fully org, att. to BIG HORN, FREMONT, and PARK "for judicial, revenue and election purposes." HOT SPRINGS had been created on 9 Feb 1911, but mapping reflects intent of leg.

properties.NAME: CONVERSE
properties.CHANGE: CONVERSE lost to creation of NIOBRARA. NIOBRARA not fully org., att. to CONVERSE "for judicial, revenue and election purposes."  CONVERSE gained terr. along former LARAMIE bdry; bdries with JOHNSON, NATRONA, and WESTON adjusted to run on survey lines

properties.NAME: NATRONA
properties.CHANGE: NATRONA lost to JOHNSON when boundary was adjusted to run on federal land survey lines. Boundary with CONVERSE was adjusted to run on federal land survey lines.

properties.NAME: LINCOLN
properties.CHANGE: LINCOLN created from UINTA. LINCOLN not fully organized, attached to UINTA "for judicial, revenue and election purposes." Technically, LINCOLN had been created on 20 February 1911, but the mapping reflects the intent of the legislature.

properties.NAME: FREMONT
properties.CHANGE: FREMONT lost to creation of HOT SPRINGS. HOT SPRINGS not fully org., part att. to FREMONT "for judicial, revenue and election purposes." FREMONT exchanged terr. along former bdry with UINTA when boundary was adjusted to run on federal land survey lines

properties.NAME: PARK
properties.CHANGE: PARK lost to creation of HOT SPRINGS. HOT SPRINGS not fully org., part att. to PARK "for judicial, revenue and election purposes." PARK lost terr. in Yellowstone NP and lost along former boundary with UINTA when boundaries were adjusted on survey lines

properties.NAME: Yellowstone NP
properties.CHANGE: That part of Yellowstone National Park located in Wyoming was removed from the jurisdiction of UINTA and PARK, and remained a non-county area outside any county jurisdiction.
properties.CITATION: Wyo. Laws 1911, 11th leg., ch. 67/pp. 93-94 and ch. 77, sec. 10/pp. 109-110

properties.NAME: FREMONT
properties.CHANGE: FREMONT lost to creation of SUBLETTE. SUBLETTE not fully organized, part attached to FREMONT "for judicial, revenue and election purposes."

properties.NAME: SUBLETTE
properties.CHANGE: SUBLETTE created from FREMONT and LINCOLN; SUBLETTE not fully organized, attached to FREMONT and LINCOLN "for judicial, revenue and election purposes."

properties.NAME: TETON
properties.CHANGE: TETON created from LINCOLN; TETON not fully organized, attached to LINCOLN "for judicial, revenue and election purposes."
properties.CITATION: Wyo. Laws 1921, 16th leg., ch. 53/pp. 45-46; "Budge, et al. v. Board of Commissioners of Lincoln County, et al.," in Wyoming Rpts., 29:35-49

properties.NAME: LINCOLN
properties.CHANGE: LINCOLN lost to creation of SUBLETTE and TETON. SUBLETTE and TETON not fully organized, part of SUBLETTE and all of TETON attached to LINCOLN "for judicial, revenue and election purposes."
properties.CITATION: Wyo. Laws 1921, 16th leg., chs. 52-53/pp. 42-46; "Budge, et al. v. Board of Commissioners of Lincoln County, et al.," in Wyoming Rpts., 29:35-49

properties.NAME: TETON
properties.CHANGE: TETON lost to LINCOLN. Efforts to halt the creation and organization of TETON were denied by the Wyoming State Supreme Court in 1923 and 1924.
properties.CITATION: Wyo. Laws 1923, 17th leg., ch. 21/pp. 34-35; "State ex rel. Budge v. Snyder," in Wyoming Rpts., 30:287-309 and 31:333-355

properties.NAME: LINCOLN
properties.CHANGE: LINCOLN gained from TETON. Efforts to halt the creation and organization of TETON were denied by the Wyoming Supreme Court in 1923 and 1924.
properties.CITATION: Wyo. Laws 1923, 17th leg., ch. 21/pp. 34-35; "State ex rel. Budge v. Snyder," in Wyoming Rpts., 30:287-309 and 31:333-355

properties.NAME: TETON
properties.CHANGE: TETON gained from LINCOLN and gained part of Yellowstone National Park, thereby placing the remainder of Yellowstone National Park in Wyoming under county jurisdiction.

properties.NAME: LINCOLN
properties.CHANGE: LINCOLN lost to TETON.

properties.NAME: Yellowstone NP
properties.CHANGE: Part of Yellowstone National Park in Wyoming became part of PARK. The rest of Yellowstone National Park in Wyoming remained a non-county area outside county jurisdiction.

properties.NAME: HOT SPRINGS
properties.CHANGE: HOT SPRINGS lost to PARK.

properties.NAME: PARK
properties.CHANGE: PARK gained from HOT SPRINGS and gained part of Yellowstone National Park. Mistake in description would have transferred a small area from TETON to PARK [not mapped; corrected 5 March 1931].

properties.NAME: PARK
properties.CHANGE: PARK lost to HOT SPRINGS. Mistake of 7 February 1929, transferring a small area of TETON to PARK, was corrected [no change].

properties.NAME: HOT SPRINGS
properties.CHANGE: HOT SPRINGS gained from PARK.

properties.NAME: CONVERSE
properties.CHANGE: CONVERSE gained from ALBANY. Act passed 10 February 1955; special election to authorize change was held 12 July 1955.
properties.CITATION: Wyo. Laws 1955, 33d leg., ch. 74/pp. 60-64; Wyoming Statutes Annotated 2001, 4:378

properties.NAME: ALBANY
properties.CHANGE: ALBANY lost to CONVERSE. Act passed 10 February 1955; special election to authorize change was held 12 July 1955.
properties.CITATION: Wyo. Laws 1955, 33d leg., ch. 74/pp. 60-64; Wyoming Statutes Annotated 2001, 4:378

properties.NAME: LINCOLN
properties.CHANGE: LINCOLN gained small area from TETON in Township 39 North, Range 117 West.

properties.NAME: TETON
properties.CHANGE: TETON lost small area to LINCOLN in Township 39 North, Range 117 West.

properties.NAME: SUMMIT (Utah)
properties.CHANGE: SUMMIT (Utah) gained from DAVIS Utah) and GREAT SALT LAKE (now SALT LAKE [Utah]); exchanged with GREEN RIVER (Utah Territory, extinct); lost to creation of MORGAN (Utah) and WASATCH (Utah), and lost to CACHE (Utah) and WEBER (Utah).

properties.NAME: CACHE (Utah)
properties.CHANGE: CACHE (Utah) gained from BOX ELDER (Utah) and SUMMIT (Utah), exchanged with GREEN RIVER (Utah Territory, extinct).

properties.NAME: GREEN RIVER (Ut Ter)
properties.CHANGE: GREEN RIVER (Utah Territory, extinct) exchanged with CACHE (Utah) and SUMMIT (Utah), lost to SANPETE (Utah), and lost to creation of WASATCH (Utah).

properties.NAME: ONEIDA (Idaho)
properties.CHANGE: ONEIDA (Idaho) lost to Dakota Territory when Dakota Territory gained from Idaho Territory.

properties.NAME: BOISE (Idaho)
properties.CHANGE: BOISE (Idaho) lost to creation of OWYHEE (Idaho); BOISE lost most of its territory in present Wyoming.

properties.NAME: BOISE (Idaho)
properties.CHANGE: BOISE (Idaho) created by Washington Territory from IDAHO (Idaho); included territory in present Idaho and Wyoming.

properties.NAME: OWYHEE (Idaho)
properties.CHANGE: OWYHEE (Idaho) created by Idaho Territory from BOISE (Idaho) and non-county area; included territory in present Idaho and most of present Wyoming west of the Rocky Mountains and south of the Snake River.
